name: web-cake-shop-site-held-up-against-sky-in-two-hands
title: Cobalt cake-shop site on a laptop held aloft against a cloudy sky
whatItIs: A rounded brown-outlined image of a bright sky with two hands holding up an open laptop. The screen shows a cobalt page with four cake cutouts in a row, hand-drawn notes and a huge cream 'THE CAKE SHOP' in tall wavy letters cropped at the bottom.
whatItMeans: Playful and celebratory; holding the laptop up like a tray offers the site like a cake.
techniques: Hold the device aloft like a serving tray.
Use a sky backdrop matching the cobalt.
Show a row of product cutouts above a cropped giant title.

vocabulary.definition: Hands presenting a device like a tray.
A giant word cut by the screen edge.
A cloudy sky used as background.
